## Change

Describe the visible change, why it is useful, and the affected themes/scopes.

## Candidate and review

- Base/source commit:
- Candidate source hash and documentation build fingerprint:
- Matching preview or offline review material:
- Relevant review feedback and its candidate version:

Keep large evidence out of source history. Confirm reviewers can access linked
material without exposing private artifacts publicly.

## Verification

List relevant checks already run and their results. Identify untested states,
manual accessibility/device checks, and other known limitations. Reuse valid
existing evidence; do not run unrelated suites solely to fill this section.

## Adoption and publication

The authored source diff and regenerated outputs implement this proposal.
Normal maintainer review and merge adopt the source. Publication is separate;
record its version/link when it happens. Exporting or viewing a candidate does
not approve, merge or publish it.
